title: Treasury Anchor
tagline: Professional treasury management tooling powered by intents & account abstraction
description:
The project allows to create Safe vaults and set up different roles with strict policies (e.g., trade limits, permitted actions) for asset managers. This allows for professional risk management & reduces potential for mistakes & malpractices. 

Direct integration with intent-based systems (e.g,. CowSwap) allows to optimize trading in large amounts as well as automate it using a separate limited role.
how_its_made:
1. Gnosis Safe Integration: Utilized the security and flexibility of Gnosis Safe vaults to manage user accounts. Enhanced the vault's functionality, enabling advanced account management features.

2. Trading integration: Established robust connections with Cow Swap and the 1inch. Facilitated efficient and secure trading operations directly from the Gnosis Safe vault.

3. Sybil Resistance Implementation: Incorporated Worldcoin's unique approach to sybil resistance. This feature ensures the authenticity and uniqueness of each user account, enhancing the overall security and integrity of the system.

4. WalletConnect: Used WalletConnect SDK to streamline user onboarding

5. Notifications & chat: Used Push protocol to enable messaging in the chat

Deploying on Gnosis Chain, Arbitrum, Scroll & Celo
